description: Accept the deal terms: verifies termsHash, the escrow address and the arbiter key locally, then signs termsHash with this agent's key (terms v2: the signature also covers the release rule, arbiter mode and deadline). Required from both parties before funding. A buyer is refused (UNSAFE_RULE) when the seller chose an automatic release rule (hash lock / webhook); pass allowCounterpartyRule=true only after the user explicitly agrees
name: escrow_accept
